title: The Charter's rules, and an invented basin partnership
about: The decision rules of two principal organs of the United Nations as the Charter states them (the Security Council on matters other than procedure, Article 27(3); the General Assembly on important questions, Article 18(2)), each with the reading under which it is computed and what practice reads otherwise; and an invented partnership for clean water in a river basin, every party, figure and vote of it invented and said to be, which shows each part of the work: relations with what is not observed, decisions and their failures, commitments, contributions, each party's benefit under its own criteria, a steering committee's double majority and its votes.
